old_findings.note: Phantom stor1 (38 lines) and its def storage line unchanged.
2 * bool(..) overflow checks (14) and the dead 'if idx >= 42' unchanged.

regressions.source: reading a long bytes member of counterpartyInfos (bytes[] merklePrefix) from storage into memory
regressions.issue: The 5 storage-to-memory bytes copies whose destination is the free-memory pointer are now while loops with a dead exit value after them; the 5 with a constant destination are still copy lines.
regressions.rule: Recognise a word-by-word copy loop (dst + 32i <- src + i, i < ceil32(n)/32) as a copy line whatever the destination expression is, a mem[64] read included.

regressions.decompiled: log 0xab3a4458..: mem[mem[64] len u - mem[64]], indexed sha3(..), indexed uint64(_29 + 1) / mem[mem[64]] = uint64(_29 + 1) / return memory from mem[64] len 32
regressions.source: ICS26Router.sendPacket: emit SendPacket(..., packet); return sequence
regressions.issue: The sequence return is no longer folded (a word stored at mem[mem[64]] then returned from mem[64] with length 32), and the event data lost its head words.
regressions.rule: return/log of mem[p len 32] right after mem[p] = x (p any expression, mem[64] included, with no write in between) is return x; print the known head words of a returned or logged memory range.

regressions.decompiled: mem[_284 + 160] = 0xa7c34e4f.. / ... / if t >= _311: revert with memory from mem[64] len v - mem[64] / mem[s] = v - mem[64] - 68
regressions.source: custom error with a bytes[] argument (revert 0xa7c34e4f(...))
regressions.issue: The selector is written at _284 + 160 and the data are read from mem[64]; these are equal (_284 = mem[64] at 4799, mem[64] = mem[64] + 160 at 4807) but not identified, so the custom error falls back to raw memory. The same revert in unknownb98c330a and unknown1bca011a still decodes.
regressions.rule: After p = mem[64]; mem[64] = mem[64] + k, a read of mem[64] is p + k: rewrite addresses into one form before matching revert data.

improvements: Reverts decoded: 0xdf95155a, 0x9fff831f, 0xa0db16fe, 0x14d71247, 0x4870bd74, 0x87dfb267, 0x837f46a6 (were mem[_V len 4]), 48 call-failure forwards are one line; two functions return Array(len=.., data=..) instead of raw memory, unknownb0777bfa's return shows 32, 64 and the length; a log in unknown5f516889 and unknown5ebd10ca decoded; stor1260 keyed by call.data instead of memory. P6 19 -> 0.
notes: Diff 2137 lines: reviewed by structure (per-function counts of calls, requires, writes, logs equal; the +1 while per function is regression 1) plus per-function diffs of multicall (delegatecall length now the value _18 + len, neutral), unknownb0777bfa, unknown4d6e7ce3 and unknown5ebd10ca. The new copy loops are semantically right (ceil32(n)/32 words).
summary: Errors and returns are decoded in most places, but three regressions tied to mem[64]-relative addresses: five storage-to-memory bytes copies became while loops, sendPacket's return and event fall back to raw memory, and one custom-error revert is no longer decoded.
